svg.aria-label: Inside Vegapunk: Stella is the front door; around it orbit Punk Records (the local base), Nomi Nomi no Mi (the search engine), York (the only write path), Shaka (formulas), Atlas and Pythagoras (the guards), Edison and Lilith (calibration) and the Memory Card (your reports).
